note: Lines a room speaks that no document writes, which predate tools/check-room-lines-sourced.mjs. The list may only shrink: a line comes off when its words are written into /docs and the room recompiled. Never add to it to get past the check -- a new unsourced line is the defect the check exists for.

lines.line: Three storeys from here. I have been round the back and it is one.
lines.why: Doc 14 writes 'Three stories from here'; the room file says 'storeys'. The content drifted from its document; whichever spelling is right belongs in doc 14.
